simple.meaning: זָקֵן (zâqên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be old.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 27 times across Genesis, Joshua, Ruth, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 18:12. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָקֵן (H2204).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זָקֵן (zâqên) / H2204 is traced through Genesis 18:12, Genesis 18:13, Genesis 19:31, Genesis 24:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2204. zaqen זָקֵן verb be or become old (compare, according to Thes, Arabic a she-camel that lets her lower lip hang down , see Lane 968 ; decrepit man ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular זָקֵן Gen 18:12 14 t. (often hard to distinguished from predicate adjective זָקֵן q. v.); 3feminine singular זָָֽקְנָה Prov 23:22 ; 2 masculine singular זָקַנְתָּ 1Sam 8:5 ; זָקַ֫נְתָּה Josh 13:1 ; 1 singular זָקַנְתִּי 23:2-3 t.; זָקַנְ֑תִּי Gen 18:13 ; 27:2 ; Imperfect וַיִּזְקַן 2Chr 24:15 ; — be (or become ) old Gen 18:12-13 , 19:31 ; 27:1-2 ,(all J), 1Sam 2:22 ; 4:18 ; 8:1 ; 8:5 ; 12:2 ; 1 Samuel 17:122; Sam 1 Samuel 19:33; 1Kin 1:1 , 15 ; 2Kin 4:14 ; also Gen 24:1 (|| בימים בא ), so Josh 13:1 (twice in verse); 23:1-2 ,(|| here בימים בָּאתִי ), 1Chr 23:1 (|| ימים שָׂבַע ), 24:15 (|| id. ); Prov 23:22 ; Psa 37:25 (opposed to || נער היה ); note especially לאישׁ מִהְיוֺת זָקַנְתִּי Ruth 1:12 I am too old to belong to a man (husband) . Hiph`il only Imperfect 3masculine singular יַזְקִין inchoate shew age, grow old = senescere Ew § 122 c , compare Di; of youth Prov 22:6 ; of tree-root Job 14:8 .
